+#!/usr/bin/env python3

+"""
+

+  --no-permissions           suppress the permissions field
+  --no-filesize              suppress the filesize field
+  --no-user                  suppress the user field
+  --no-time                  suppress the time field
+  --stdin                    read file names from stdin, one per line or other separator

+  --git                      list each file's Git status, if tracked or ignored
+  --no-git                   suppress Git status (always overrides --git,
+                             --git-repos, --git-repos-no-status)
+  --git-repos                list root of git-tree status
+  --git-repos-no-status      list each git-repos branch name (much faster)
+    
+"""
+
+
+WHEN = ("always", "auto", "never")
+SORT_CHOICES = (
+    "name", "Name", "size", "extension", "Extension", "modified",
+    "changed", "accessed", "created", "inode", "type", "none",
+)
+TIME_CHOICES = ("modified", "changed", "accessed", "created")
+TIME_STYLE_CHOICES = ("default", "long-iso", "full-iso", "iso", "relative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ArgSpec:
+    short: str | None
+    long: str
+    value_kind: str = "forbidden"
+    choices: tuple[str, ...] | None = None
+    default: str | None = None
+
+    def option_name(self) -> str:
+        suffix = f" (-{self.short})" if self.short is not None else ""
+        return f"--{self.long}{suffix}"
+
+
+def spec(short: str | None, long: str, kind: str = "forbidden",
+         choices: tuple[str, ...] | None = None, default: str | None = None) -> ArgSpec:
+    return ArgSpec(short, long, kind, choices, default)
+
+
+SPECS = [
+    spec("v", "version"), spec("?", "help"),
+    spec("1", "oneline"), spec("l", "long"), spec("G", "grid"),
+    spec("x", "across"), spec("R", "recurse"), spec("T", "tree"),
+    spec("F", "classify", "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+    spec("X", "dereference"), spec("w", "width", "necessary"),
+    spec(None, "no-quotes"),
+    spec(None, "absolute", "optional", ("on", "follow", "off"), "on"),
+    spec(None, "follow-symlinks"),
+    spec(None, "color", "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+    spec(None, "colour", "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+    spec(None, "color-scale", "optional", ("all", "size", "age"), "all"),
+    spec(None, "colour-scale", "optional", ("all", "size", "age"), "all"),
+    spec(None, "color-scale-mode", "necessary", ("fixed", "gradient")),
+    spec(None, "colour-scale-mode", "necessary", ("fixed", "gradient")),
+    spec("a", "all"), spec("A", "almost-all"),
+    spec("d", "treat-dirs-as-files"), spec(None, "list-dirs"),
+    spec("L", "level", "necessary"), spec("r", "reverse"),
+    spec("s", "sort", "necessary", SORT_CHOICES),
+    spec("I", "ignore-glob", "necessary"), spec(None, "git-ignore"),
+    spec(None, "group-directories-first"), spec(None, "group-directories-last"),
+    spec("D", "only-dirs"), spec("f", "only-files"),
+    spec(None, "no-symlinks"), spec(None, "show-symlinks"),
+    spec("b", "binary"), spec("B", "bytes"), spec("g", "group"),
+    spec("n", "numeric"), spec("h", "header"),
+    spec(None, "icons", "optional", WHEN, "auto"),
+    spec("i", "inode"), spec("H", "links"), spec("m", "modified"),
+    spec(None, "changed"), spec("S", "blocksize"), spec(None, "total-size"),
+    spec("t", "time", "necessary", TIME_CHOICES), spec("u", "accessed"),
+    spec("U", "created"), spec(None, "time-style", "necessary", TIME_STYLE_CHOICES),
+    spec(None, "hyperlink"), spec("M", "mounts"), spec(None, "smart-group"),
+    spec(None, "no-permissions"), spec(None, "no-filesize"),
+    spec(None, "no-user"), spec(None, "no-time"),
+    spec(None, "git"), spec(None, "no-git"), spec(None, "git-repos"),
+    spec(None, "git-repos-no-status"), spec("@", "extended"),
+    spec("o", "octal-permissions"), spec("Z", "context"),
+    spec(None, "stdin"), spec("O", "flags"),
+]
+BY_LONG = {item.long: item for item in SPECS}
+BY_SHORT = {item.short: item for item in SPECS if item.short is not None}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Flag:
+    kind: str
+    text: str
+
+    def __str__(self) -> str:
+        return ("--" if self.kind == "long" else "-") + self.text
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Match:
+    spec: ArgSpec
+    flag: Flag
+    value: str | None
+
+
+class OptionFailure(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def choices_text(values: Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    return "choices: " + ", ".join(values)
+
+
+def debug_string(value: str) -> str:
+    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+
+class MatchedFlags:
+    def __init__(self, matches: list[Match], strict: bool):
+        self.matches = matches
+        self.strict = strict
+
+    def records(self, *names: str, with_value: bool | None = None) -> list[Match]:
+        result = [item for item in self.matches if item.spec.long in names]
+        if with_value is not None:
+            result = [item for item in result if (item.value is not None) == with_value]
+        return result
+
+    def count(self, name: str) -> int:
+        return len(self.records(name))
+
+    def has(self, name: str) -> bool:
+        found = self.records(name, with_value=False)
+        if self.strict and len(found) > 1:
+            self._duplicate(found)
+        return bool(found)
+
+    def has_any(self, names: Sequence[str]) -> Match | None:
+        found = [item for item in self.matches if item.spec.long in names and item.value is None]
+        if self.strict and len(found) > 1:
+            self._duplicate(found)
+        return found[-1] if found else None
+
+    def get(self, name: str) -> str | None:
+        found = self.records(name, with_value=True)
+        if self.strict and len(found) > 1:
+            self._duplicate(found)
+        return found[-1].value if found else None
+
+    def get_any(self, names: Sequence[str]) -> Match | None:
+        found = [item for item in self.matches if item.spec.long in names and item.value is not None]
+        if self.strict and len(found) > 1:
+            self._duplicate(found)
+        return found[-1] if found else None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _duplicate(found: Sequence[Match]) -> None:
+        a, b = found[0].flag, found[1].flag
+        if a == b:
+            raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {a} was given twice")
+        raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {a} conflicts with flag {b}")
+
+
+def parse_arguments(argv: Sequence[str], strict: bool) -> tuple[MatchedFlags, list[str]]:
+    matches: list[Match] = []
+    frees: list[str] = []
+    parsing = True
+    index = 0
+    while index < len(argv):
+        token = argv[index]
+        index += 1
+        if not parsing:
+            frees.append(token)
+            continue
+        if token == "--":
+            parsing = False
+            continue
+        if token.startswith("--"):
+            raw = token[2:]
+            before, separator, after = raw.partition("=")
+            split = bool(separator and before and after)
+            name = before if split else raw
+            item = BY_LONG.get(name)
+            if item is None:
+                raise OptionFailure(f"Unknown argument --{name}")
+            flag = Flag("long", item.long)
+            if split:
+                if item.value_kind == "forbidden":
+                    raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {flag} cannot take a value")
+                matches.append(Match(item, flag, after))
+            elif item.value_kind == "forbidden":
+                matches.append(Match(item, flag, None))
+            elif item.value_kind == "necessary":
+                if index >= len(argv):
+                    suffix = f" ({choices_text(item.choices)})" if item.choices else ""
+                    raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {flag} needs a value{suffix}")
+                matches.append(Match(item, flag, argv[index]))
+                index += 1
+            else:
+                value = item.default
+                if index < len(argv) and item.choices and argv[index] in item.choices:
+                    value = argv[index]
+                    index += 1
+                matches.append(Match(item, flag, value))
+            continue
+        if token.startswith("-") and token != "-":
+            raw = token[1:]
+            before, separator, after = raw.partition("=")
+            if separator and before and after:
+                ordinary = before[:-1]
+                valued = before[-1]
+                for char in ordinary:
+                    item = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                    if item is None:
+                        raise OptionFailure(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                    flag = Flag("short", char)
+                    if item.value_kind == "necessary":
+                        suffix = f" ({choices_text(item.choices)})" if item.choices else ""
+                        raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {flag} needs a value{suffix}")
+                    value = item.default if item.value_kind == "optional" else None
+                    matches.append(Match(item, flag, value))
+                item = BY_SHORT.get(valued)
+                if item is None:
+                    raise OptionFailure(f"Unknown argument -{valued}")
+                flag = Flag("short", valued)
+                if item.value_kind == "forbidden":
+                    raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {flag} cannot take a value")
+                matches.append(Match(item, flag, after))
+                continue
+            position = 0
+            while position < len(raw):
+                char = raw[position]
+                position += 1
+                item = BY_SHORT.get(char)
+                if item is None:
+                    raise OptionFailure(f"Unknown argument -{char}")
+                flag = Flag("short", char)
+                tail = raw[position:]
+                if item.value_kind == "forbidden":
+                    matches.append(Match(item, flag, None))
+                    continue
+                if item.value_kind == "necessary":
+                    if tail:
+                        matches.append(Match(item, flag, tail))
+                    elif index < len(argv):
+                        matches.append(Match(item, flag, argv[index]))
+                        index += 1
+                    else:
+                        suffix = f" ({choices_text(item.choices)})" if item.choices else ""
+                        raise OptionFailure(f"Flag {flag} needs a value{suffix}")
+                    break
+                if tail and item.choices and tail in item.choices:
+                    matches.append(Match(item, flag, tail))
+                    break
+                if tail.startswith("="):
+                    value = tail[1:]
+                    if not value:
+                        raise OptionFailure(f"Unknown argument -=")
+                    matches.append(Match(item, flag, value))
+                    break
+                if not tail and index < len(argv) and item.choices and argv[index] in item.choices:
+                    matches.append(Match(item, flag, argv[index]))
+                    index += 1
+                else:
+                    matches.append(Match(item, flag, item.default))
+            continue
+        frees.append(token)
+    return MatchedFlags(matches, strict), frees
+
+
+def bad_argument(item: ArgSpec, value: str) -> OptionFailure:
+    suffix = f" ({choices_text(item.choices)})" if item.choices else ""
+    return OptionFailure(
+        f"Option {item.option_name()} has no {debug_string(value)} setting{suffix}"
+    )
+
+
+def parse_usize(value: str, item: ArgSpec) -> int:
+    if not value or not value.isdecimal():
+        detail = "invalid digit found in string"
+        raise OptionFailure(
+            f"Value {debug_string(value)} not valid for option {item.option_name()}: {detail}"
+        )
+    return int(value)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Options:
+    mode: str = "lines"
+    width: int | None = None
+    is_tty: bool = False
+    across: bool = False
+    dir_action: str = "list"
+    level: int | None = None
+    dot_filter: str = "just"
+    sort: str = "name"
+    reverse: bool = False
+    dirs_first: bool = False
+    dirs_last: bool = False
+    ignore_patterns: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
+    only_dirs: bool = False
+    only_files: bool = False
+    no_symlinks: bool = False
+    show_symlinks: bool = False
+    quote: bool = True
+    classify: str = "never"
+    absolute: str = "off"
+    dereference: bool = False
+    follow_symlinks: bool = False
+    stdin: bool = False
+    header: bool = False
+    permissions: bool = True
+    filesize: bool = True
+    user: bool = True
+    size_format: str = "decimal"
+    time_style: str = "default"
+    time_types: list[str] = field(default_factory=lambda: ["modified"])
+    file_flags: bool = False
+    links: bool = False
+    inode: bool = False
+    group: bool = False
+    blocksize: bool = False
+    octal: bool = False
+    numeric: bool = False
+    total_size: bool = False
+
+
+def deduce_options(flags: MatchedFlags, environ: dict[str, str]) -> Options:
+    result = Options()
+
+    width_value = flags.get("width")
+    if width_value is not None:
+        parsed = parse_usize(width_value, BY_LONG["width"])
+        result.width = parsed if parsed >= 1 else None
+        result.is_tty = parsed >= 1
+    elif "COLUMNS" in environ:
+        value = environ["COLUMNS"]
+        if not value.isdecimal():
+            raise OptionFailure(
+                f"Value {debug_string(value)} not valid for environment variable COLUMNS: invalid digit found in string"
+            )
+        result.width = int(value)
+        result.is_tty = True
+    else:
+        result.is_tty = sys.stdout.isatty()
+        if result.is_tty:
+            result.width = shutil.get_terminal_size((80, 24)).columns
+
+    primary = flags.has_any(("long", "oneline", "grid", "tree"))
+    if primary is None:
+        result.mode = "grid" if result.is_tty else "lines"
+    elif primary.spec.long == "long" or (
+        primary.spec.long in ("tree", "grid") and flags.has("long")
